messages.subject: htmlOutput vs. uiOutput
parts: Is there a difference between htmlOutput and uiOutput. Seeing the function code, they appear to be the same. In fact, even tableOutput provides the same code. But I was wondering if there is a difference under the hood?

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: htmlOutput vs. uiOutput
parts:
try:

library(shiny)
?htmlOutput

"uiOutput is intended to be used with reactiveUI on the server side. It is currently just an alias for htmlOutput."
